summary: The next residual rises with the previous residual. The slope stays above zero for expected points and for score_xp, including when the previous week had at least 60 minutes. That is persistence, not a bounce. No reversion term is added. Same-fixture minutes beat the historical xmi on the one-week transfer, and the gap versus expected points covers zero. Those minutes are not a pre-deadline forecast. score_xp is unchanged.
